name: AT-076
summary: AT-076 is a so-called opioid "pan" antagonist and is the first reasonably balanced antagonist known of all four opioid receptor types.75 nM). AT-076 was derived from the κ-opioid receptor antagonist JDTic, which showed affinity for NOP, by removal of two methyl groups from the piperidine ring. This increased affinity for NOP 10-fold relative to the parent compound.
